examples.en: I often get compared to my older sister, and it upsets me.
The prices of the two companies can be compared at a glance.

examples.ko: 다른 사람과 비교되면 기분이 좋지 않아요.
examples.en: I don't feel good when I'm compared with others.

examples.ko: 이 두 식당은 맛과 가격이 자주 비교되는 곳이에요.
examples.en: These two restaurants are often compared on taste and price.

examples.ko: 새 영화는 전편과 비교될 수밖에 없어요.
examples.en: The new movie can't help being compared with the original.
Children really dislike being compared to their siblings.

explain: '비교하다'는 내가 견주는 것이고, '비교되다'는 견주어지는 쪽이에요. 'A가 B와 비교되다'처럼 '와/과'를 써요. 형제나 친구와 비교되는 일은 기분이 상하기 쉬워서, 한국에서는 '비교하지 마세요'라는 말을 자주 해요.

phrases.en: I don't like being compared with my older brother.
phrases.nuance_ko: '-는 게 싫다'로 비교당하는 불편한 마음을 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: '-는 게 싫다' expresses the discomfort of being compared.

phrases.example: 이 가게는 늘 옆 가게와 비교돼요.
phrases.en: This shop is always compared with the shop next door.
phrases.nuance_en: '와/과' marks the thing being compared with.

phrases.example: 두 가게의 음식이 자꾸 서로 비교돼요.
phrases.en: The food at the two shops keeps getting compared with each other.
phrases.nuance_ko: '서로'와 함께 두 대상이 함께 견주어진다는 뜻이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: With '서로', it means two things are being weighed against each other.
phrases.en_equiv: to be compared with each other

explain_en: '비교하다' is you comparing; '비교되다' is being the one compared. The pattern is 'A가 B와 비교되다' with '와/과'. Being compared to a sibling or friend easily hurts feelings, so '비교하지 마세요' is a common thing to say in Korea.

en: to be referred to; to be consulted

examples.en: This material was referred to in the report.
Your opinions will be taken into account.
The book that was consulted is in the library.
This will be considered in the review.

examples.ko: 이 문서가 참고되고 있는지 확인해 주세요.
examples.en: Please check whether this document is being referred to.

explain: 자료나 의견이 판단하거나 결정할 때 도움으로 쓰인다는 말이에요. 내가 볼 때는 '참고하다'를 써요. '참고로 말씀드리면'은 덧붙여 알려 줄 때 쓰는 표현이에요.

phrases.en: This book is a helpful reference for studying.
phrases.nuance_en: '참고가 되다' means it is helpful and is close to 참고되다.

phrases.en: The students' opinions were taken into account in the plan.
phrases.nuance_en: '~에 참고되다' tells where something was used as a reference.

phrases.example: 이 자료가 지금 보고서에 참고되고 있어요.
phrases.en: This material is being used as a reference for the report now.
phrases.nuance_ko: 지금 참고 자료로 쓰이는 중이라고 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used to say something is being used as a reference right now.

explain_en: It means a source or opinion is used as an aid when judging or deciding. When you are the one consulting, the active verb is used. A related phrase, 'for your reference', is used to add extra information.
